# Spears (skill)

Description: Determines, damage, and, stamina, cost with Spears (skill).

# Introduction

Spears (skill) is a skill related to Spears class.

## Effects

Higher skill level in spears reduces the stamina cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

## Leveling up

The player gains 2.25xp per primary attack and 1.5xp per secondary attack when hitting a creature.
